meta.study: NVDA VWAP absolute bracket tail-risk overlay; no 95% rule

selection.development_gate: net PnL >= baseline; winner retention is diagnostic/penalty, not a percent gate
selection.method: No overlay passed dev/validation net non-degradation + risk + robust utility + neighbour stability gates
selection.robust_rule: positive max of min(development utility, validation utility) with >=50% positive gated immediate neighbours; otherwise BASE
selection.utility: net delta + 0.35*positive MTM-MDD reduction + 0.50*positive CVaR5 reduction + 0.20*positive worst-5 loser savings - clipped winner net dollars
selection.validation_gate: net PnL >= baseline; >=5% MTM-MDD/CVaR5/worst-trade improvement; no material damage to those tail metrics, Sharpe or PF

execution.entry: VWAP-Z close event; next raw open
execution.priority: at expiry: adverse stop gap then time at open; otherwise stop, target, forced EOD
execution.raw_data: exact synchronized Alpaca SIP 1-minute QQQ/NVDA RTH
execution.time_stop_fill: raw expiry-minute open; expiry high/low never inspected

stop3_comparison.selection_role: diagnostic only; holdout never used to select
